summary.content:
Today's selection covers 87 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 48 on Artificial Intelligence and 16 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Google’s first smart speaker in six years arrives next week
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Rokarolla Android Trojan Levels Up to Full Device Control, Persistence
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, BBC Technology, Dark Reading, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 52 articles published in the last 24 hours
